map.💡 支持捕获组引用：$1 $2 $3... 表示第 N 个捕获组；$& 表示整个: 💡 Capture-group references supported: $1 $2 $3... is the Nth group; $& is the whole match; $` is text before the match; $' is text after the match.
map.批量改写：用正则捕获组重排文本，如把「姓,名」转「名 姓」。: Batch rewrite: use regex capture groups to rearrange text, e.g. turn "last,first" into "first last".
map.数据规整：统一日期格式、替换域名、清洗噪声字符。: Data normalization: unify date formats, replace domains, clean noisy characters.
map.模板渲染：用反向引用把抽出内容填回新模板。: Template rendering: use back-references to plug extracted content back into a new template.
map.用正则「@(qq|163).com」替换为「@corp.com」，把两域名邮箱统: Use regex "@(qq|163).com" replaced with "@corp.com" to unify two domains to the corporate domain; capture group $1 can be referenced in the replacement for partial rewrites.
map.用括号分组，替换串里以 $1、$2 引用；如「([0-9]{4})-([0-9]: Group with parentheses and reference them in the replacement as $1, $2; e.g. "([0-9]{4})-([0-9]{2})" replaced with "$2/$1" swaps month and year. Mind escaping and the global flag.
map.正则匹配范围广，建议先在小样本预览再应用到全量；涉及破坏性替换务必备份原文本。: Regex matches broadly; preview on a small sample before applying to everything; for destructive replacements always back up the original text.
map.如何使用高级替换: How to use Advanced Find & Replace
map.在文本中按普通或正则规则批量替换内容，支持区分大小写、整词匹配与分组引用，适合清: Batch-replace content in text by plain or regex rules, with case-sensitivity, whole-word matching and group references; ideal for log cleaning, template rewriting and bulk text fixes.
